dedupe_keys.name: flex depot multi market flexibility commercialisation of a logistics depot with electric trucks

description: FLEX-DEPOT is a Python framework that optimises how a logistics depot with electric trucks sells its flexibility across electricity markets. It was published on Code Ocean in 2026 (version 2.0) by Marcel Brödel. It combines market price series, flexibility power and energy bands of the depot's aggregated assets, and market trading rules in one rolling-horizon model predictive control loop. At its core is a mixed-integer or linear Pyomo model that decides market positions and the physical power flow between depot and public grid while respecting flexibility bounds and gate-closure rules. It handles day-ahead and intraday spot markets together, is designed to add further markets, can run a second optimisation with imbalance settlement to ensure feasibility, commits positions when gate closure is reached, reads and writes CSV files and plots dispatch, prices and cash flows with Plotly. Coverage is not tied to a place. The capsule is downloadable from Code Ocean, which may need a free account, with code under Apache 2.0 at no cost. Caveats: example data carry a custom licence, and the framework models one depot, not a fleet or grid. Simulation uses are studying electric truck charging flexibility and market participation. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
